text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Our company"!! "This company"!!
"Your company"!! "*Your* companyyy"!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sha, sha, sha, SHAAAAHHH!!!!
Did you see that?! That's my win!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Losing to a weirdo like this...
Seriously, no way...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh? What's your deal, you tryin' to act tough?
You still wanna go? Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm, like, seriously ticked off.
Just so you know, it's not ending like this.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm definitely gonna win next time.
In, like, a big race."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, a big one, right?!
Alright, bring it on!!
I might end up competing against Tosen Jordan again in the near future.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Also... this.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Just remembered I was told to hand you this.
Later.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Aha, I see now.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it says "Can" on it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: First it was the "Su" I got from Flash the other day, and now "kan"... I see.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —I don't get this at aaall!!

Still, with Tosen Jordan handing over a keyword right after Eishin Flash...
that means—

There is no doubt someone
entrusted those things to them.
choice_data_list: (I wonder who asked her to do that...?)

text_block_list.text:
I wonder whose motives lie behind
the Eden Gold Ship is chasing.
Just as I was pondering that—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Gold Shiiip~~!! Congrats on back-to-back victories~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You had me on edge thinking
you were gonna mess up~~!! Congratulations~~!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, thanks a bunch--!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hm, wait a second, back-to-back victories?
...What are you talking about?
choice_data_list: Because you won the Takarazuka Kinen last year too.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wait, seriously?
Then I'm actually super awesome.
choice_data_list: It's so amazing it'll etch her name in history.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Hey now, get more hyped up! Bring on that super hyped celebratory mood!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Let's buy some red-and-white steamed buns on the way home for now. I'll only give you the skin to eat, though.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Gahaha! You really went and made your mark at last, huh~!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like I went and pulled off
a historic feat~! Tahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-chan really is the type who
thrives on praise, after all~

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Make sure you keep showering me with way more praise
than I need in situations like this, okay~?!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Still, hearing you say that
just fires up my soul even more...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Next year, I'm gonna go at it even hotter!
Right from the start of the race... no, I'll unleash all that blazing heat right at the starting gate!

"Right now is the third year of the 'first three years.'
I don't know about next year. And besides—"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Burn, my soul! Burn down the gatesーー!!"

"She might end up causing trouble..."
An uneasy thought crossed my mind.
